<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sn_opty_mgmt_core_opportunity</collection><condition/><description>Auto-populates Probability % from Forecast Category: Pipeline 10, Upside 30, Strong Upside 50, Commit 80, Won 100, Omitted 0. Runs after 'Set forecast category' (order 100) and before 'Set Amount And Weighted Amount' (550).</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="sn_opty_mgmt_core_opportunity">forecast_categoryVALCHANGES^EQ<item endquery="false" field="forecast_category" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="VALCHANGES" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Set probability from forecast category</name><order>150</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

	var PROBABILITY_BY_CATEGORY = {
		'Pipeline': 10,
		'Upside': 30,
		'Strong Upside': 50,
		'Commit': 80,
		'Won': 100,
		'Omitted': 0
	};

	var categoryName = current.forecast_category.getDisplayValue();
	if (PROBABILITY_BY_CATEGORY.hasOwnProperty(categoryName))
		current.setValue('probability', PROBABILITY_BY_CATEGORY[categoryName]);

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-16 19:38:43</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>e266dfdc93841310e84732e548373c64</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Set probability from forecast category</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_e266dfdc93841310e84732e548373c64</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-16 19:38:43</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=e266dfdc93841310e84732e548373c64"/></record_update>
